items.question: Which class creates a window with a title bar in AWT?
items.explanation: Frame is a window. A Panel is a box inside a window, a Canvas is a drawing area, and a Label is text.
items.hint: The lesson is called "Your first window".

items.question: Complete the code so the window appears on screen. Type the method name.
items.explanation: A Frame is hidden until you call setVisible(true).
items.hint: The method name starts with set.

items.question: A student clicks the X of a Frame, but nothing happens. Why?
options: An AWT window does not close by itself. You must add a window listener
items.explanation: You must handle the windowClosing event, for example with a WindowAdapter that calls System.exit(0).
items.hint: Think about what the first lesson added to close the window.

items.question: Which component shows one line of text that the user can edit? Type the class name.
items.explanation: TextField is one line of input. TextArea is for several lines, and Label cannot be edited.
items.hint: The name says it: a field for text.

items.question: Complete the code to read what the user typed in the field. Type the method name.
items.explanation: getText() returns the text in the field. setText(...) changes it.

items.question: Which layout has five areas: NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST and CENTER?
items.explanation: BorderLayout has those five areas, and it is the default layout of a Frame.
items.hint: The areas are on the border and in the centre.

items.question: How many equal cells does new GridLayout(2, 3) make?
Complete the code so the message prints when the button is clicked. Type the method name.
items.explanation: addActionListener tells the button which code to run when it is clicked.
items.hint: It adds a listener for actions.

items.question: Where is the point (0, 0) when you draw with Graphics?
items.explanation: (0, 0) is the top-left corner. x grows to the right and y grows downward.

items.question: Write the paint method that draws a filled red circle at x = 50, y = 50 with a diameter of 80.
items.explanation: setColor chooses the colour. fillOval(x, y, width, height) draws a filled oval, and a circle is an oval with equal width and height.
